concerns.text: FR-005 and US3 Acceptance Scenario 2 require reporting 'variation in classification stability (measured as the standard deviation of the classification rate relative to the model's RMSE)'. Task T033 only calculates the SD of the classification rates. There is no task to normalize this SD by the RMSE or report the ratio, leaving the specific metric defined in the spec unimplemented.

The plan and spec require explicit data provenance and sensitivity verification artifacts. T045 (data_summary.md) and T048 (sensitivity_sweep.csv) are marked as 'Conditional' in Phase 7 and appear to be legacy/revision tasks that were not fully integrated into the main flow. T051 and T052 in Phase 8 attempt to address this, but T045/T048 remain as dangling 'Conditional' tasks with no clear execution path, creating ambiguity on whether the 'Required change' deliverables are covered by the primary pipeline or only conditional revisions.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires a 'Reference-Validator Agent' to verify citations against primary sources before use. T008 (acquisition) and T050 (test) only check for data volume (N < 50). There is no task implementing the citation verification logic (Title-token-overlap check) mandated by the Constitution, leaving the 'Verified Accuracy' gate unfulfilled in the implementation plan.

US1 Independent Test requires verifying the output CSV contains *only* FCC self-diffusion entries. T017 tests 'filtering logic on mixed-structure mock data'. There is no explicit task to run the ingestion pipeline against the *real* fetched data (from T008) to verify the filtering criteria on real-world noise, creating a gap between mock success and real-world validation.

Tasks T045 and T048 are marked as 'Conditional' and 'Revision' but reference artifacts (`data/curated/data_summary.md`, `reports/sensitivity_sweep.csv`) that are also targeted by T051 and T052 in Phase 8. This creates duplicate/conflicting task definitions for the same deliverables, which is a documentation inconsistency.
